After calling DrugDealer(), the ceoAddress must change to the caller (msg.sender) if the caller is the current ceoAddres
The marketDrugs amount after any call to DrugDealer equals the sum of all collectDrugs market fee contributions divided
After calling collectDrugs, the caller's Kilos value is set to the newKilos value (equal to drugsUsed / DRUGS_TO_PRODUCE
The caller's claimedDrugs balance after collectDrugs should be exactly equal to the amount that was added to the referra
After any user calls DrugDealer, their claimedDrugs balance is exactly the amount calculated by calculateDrugBuy minus t
After a call to collectDrugs, the timestamp lastCollect[caller] must be updated to the current block timestamp.
For any user `adr` who calls `getFreeKilo()`, the value of `lastCollect[adr]` must be set to the current block timestamp
